item.title: Intercepting all Android traffic with ZAP
item.description: zaptun is a community add-on by David Araújo that captures all of the traffic from an Android emulator or rooted device in ZAP with one click. It uses a VPN rather than a proxy, so apps that ignore the system proxy can’t hide from you. Here’s how it works.
